paper_id: Intent-Aware Interactive Internet of Things for Enhanced Collaborative Ambient Intelligence
title: Intent-aware Interactive Web of Things for Enhanced Collaborative Ambient Intelligence
venue: IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo
motivation: IoT设备能感知却不能自主执行动作,机器人在智能家居中缺乏物理交互能力
problem_framing: 多模态传感器数据下的活动预测问题,活动边界模糊且可并发重叠
key_insight: 将意图推断与PCHID强化学习方法结合,让机械臂通过子目标序列完成复杂任务
method_signature: 意图推断→语义搜索→PCHID多步目标控制的三阶段框架
evaluation_criteria: RLBench任务成功率及训练收敛速度对比HER与DQN
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 环境预设依赖专家劳动,无法动态发现新物品或学习未记录活动
evidence_for_taste: successfully adapted connected things in our daily life
cannot control any device to take the actions accordingly
certain amount of expertise labor work
thinking_moves: 将意图推断问题从感知层面扩展到执行层面
借鉴机器人领域的PCHID解决语义目标到动作的映射
承认预设环境是系统瓶颈并指出未来方向
通过真实演示验证仿真结果的可行性
cites_own_work: Lina Yao et al. 2018 - WITS IoT-endowed framework
Altulyan et al. 2021 - Contextual Bandit Activity recommendation
extraction_notes: 作者Zhongjie Wang为哈尔滨工业大学合作作者,贡献主要在框架整合与实验验证部分,具体技术细节如PCHID等方法论来自合作团队
